verdict.rationale: Bento's own marketing copy says it ties sales and recurring revenue back to the email or flow that preceded them. That covers conversion attribution per campaign or flow, but nothing in the pack documents reporting on opens, clicks or unsubscribes, per-step automation metrics, or trends over time. Broadcast history review is about past sends, not engagement analytics. Missing for 10: documented open/click/unsubscribe metrics per campaign, per-automation-step reporting, time-series views, and first-party analytics docs or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can read opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions per campaign and per automation step, over time

citations.quote: Tie sales and recurring revenue back to the email or flow that came before.
